explanation: 'Subvert' matlab tahas-nahas ya kamzor karna, aur 'uphold' matlab banaye rakhna. Paise ka use democratic process ko 'subvert' (barbaad) karega, aur ameer candidates chunavi nateeje (mandate) ko apne fayde ke liye 'uphold' (banaye/control me) rakhna chahenge, yahan subvert ki jagah manipulate hona chahiye tha par contextually subvert is better at A.
trick: Money power democracy ko 'uphold' (samarthan) nahi karta, 'subvert' (nast) karta hai. Aur affluent candidates process ko 'subvert' karte hain. A aur C ke verbs apna place change karenge.
tip: Money power democracy ko hamesha 'subvert' karta hai.

explanation: 'Curtail' matlab kam karna, aur 'bolster' matlab majboot karna. Ghata (deficit) hone ki wajah se treasury me paisa nahi hai (limited headroom), isliye minister ko public spending 'curtail' (kam) karni padegi, bajaye infrastructure ko 'bolster' (badhane) ke.
trick: Jab sarkar ke paas paisa kam (limited headroom) ho, toh wo kharcha 'bolster' (badha) nahi sakti. Use kharcha 'curtail' karna padega. Logic ke hisaab se verbs swap karein.
tip: Fiscal deficit hone par public spending ko 'curtail' kiya jata hai.
